questions.question: Name four foods that come from plants and say which part of the plant each one is.
questions.expected_answer: For example: maize meal from maize seeds, bread from wheat seeds, spinach from leaves, potatoes or carrots from underground parts, apples or oranges from fruit, beans from seeds in pods.

questions.question: Name four foods that come from animals.
questions.expected_answer: For example: beef from cattle, chicken, milk and cheese from cows, eggs from hens, fish such as pilchards, and honey made by bees.

questions.question: What does classify mean? Explain how to classify a food made from other foods, such as cheese or peanut butter.
questions.expected_answer: To classify means to sort things into groups that belong together. For a food made from other foods, look at its main ingredient. Cheese is made from milk, so it is an animal food. Peanut butter is made from peanuts, so it is a plant food.
